sources.title: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, CA_AlamedaCounty_2021_B21 (lidar 2021, published 2022-08-10); USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, CA_NoCAL_Wildfires_B5b_2018 (lidar 2018, published 2020-03-18)
sources.why: Read overview level 2 (4 m) of each 1 m Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF via HTTP range requests; nearest overview pixel to each 4 m cell centre; Alameda 2021 has priority, NoCAL 2018 fills cells it does not cover. Overviews are averages computed by USGS/GDAL from the 1 m data. Bare-earth terrain. It does not show buildings, stairs, retaining walls, or whether a route is passable, and it does not determine fire behaviour.
